data.one_liner: Tizen implementation of the video_player plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Tizen-specific implementation for the video_player plugin based on the Tizen Media Player API. It allows playing videos on Galaxy Watch devices and Smart TVs running Tizen 5.5 or above.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting Tizen devices such as Smart TVs or Galaxy Watches.
You need to play video files or network URLs inside a Tizen Flutter application using the standard video_player API.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Tizen, such as Android or iOS.
You are running your app on TV emulators.
strengths: Enables video playback on Tizen devices using the familiar video_player plugin interface.
Supports audio track selection and display sleep prevention options.
weaknesses: Certain options and methods such as background playback and video track selection are not supported.
Has specific limitations regarding seekTo accuracy and httpHeaders support.
data.setup_notes: Include video_player and video_player_tizen in pubspec.yaml. Declare necessary privileges like mediastorage, externalstorage, and internet in tizen-manifest.xml.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: The core platform-agnostic package required alongside video_player_tizen.
